questions.question: State the general formula for alkanes and give the IUPAC name of the compound with the formula C5H12.

Compare the rates of nucleophilic substitution and elimination when 1-bromopropane is reacted with aqueous NaOH and hot ethanolic NaOH, respectively.
State the products of the reaction between 2-methyl-2-butene and HBr, and explain which product is major.
Describe how the bromine test can be used to determine the presence of unsaturation in an organic sample.
Explain why the chlorination of methane proceeds via a free‑radical mechanism rather than an ionic mechanism.
